title: Attendance Roster — the Team A rotation and its five cycle lines
caption: Current SLERPTECH IT3 company master, captured 13 November 2026. This is a draft setup example pending company review, not an approved employee assignment.
publication: Read-only capture on 13 November 2026. No attendance or payroll transaction was performed for this screenshot.
crop: ERP workspace only: browser tabs, address bar, bookmarks, account header and unrelated sidebar removed.

focus.explanation: Check the work organization, rotation mode, five-day cycle, cycle start date and Asia/Colombo time zone.
Offsets 0, 1 and 2 carry Day, Evening and Night shifts. Offsets 3 and 4 are rest days. A day offset is a cycle position, not a calendar day of the month.
The example proposes 60 unpaid minutes starting 240 minutes after shift start. Review break relief and applicability before approval.
An Active checkbox alone does not approve the roster or assign it to an employee. Use the independent review and effective assignment steps.

outcome: A reviewed roster version plus an effective, approved assignment must resolve one schedule for each employee-day.

title: Attendance Policy — configured rules and unresolved review fields
caption: Current IT3 draft policy, captured 13 November 2026 as HR Admin. Zero grace and no rounding are proposals in this master, not Sri Lankan statutory defaults.
publication: Read-only capture on 13 November 2026. No attendance or payroll transaction was performed for this screenshot.
crop: ERP workspace only: browser tabs, address bar, bookmarks, account header and unrelated sidebar removed.

focus.explanation: Distinguish an explicitly configured zero from an unreviewed value. Enter only the rules approved for the company and effective dates.
Review the relationship between scheduled breaks and policy treatment; do not deduct a break twice.
Unreviewed or blocked values require a separate decision. They are not permission to calculate a deduction or payable overtime.
Retain the company review reference and the approved version. Assign that reviewed version through Policy Assignments.

outcome: The policy is independently reviewed and its effective assignment covers the employee-day without overlap or gaps.

title: Attendance Import & Review — start with upload settings, then preview
caption: Current form at first open, captured 13 November 2026 as HR Admin. No batch is selected in this view, so it does not show an import result.
publication: Read-only capture on 13 November 2026. No attendance or payroll transaction was performed for this screenshot.
crop: ERP workspace only: browser tabs, address bar, bookmarks, account header and unrelated sidebar removed.

focus.explanation: Select the employees’ work organization, inclusive date range and attendance document type. Include the actual next-day timestamps for overnight work.
Upload a file or resume a saved batch. A saved batch retains its source and review history; New upload starts a separate upload context.
Build the current validation result. Expand Batch overview & filters to see ready groups, issues and the scope before importing.
Click a row to open its evidence and correction details. Filters help investigation; they do not reduce the all-ready scope of Review import.
This remains disabled until a current preview has eligible ready groups and the role has the necessary access.

outcome: A current preview reports ready groups and exceptions. Review the final confirmation before native Draft attendance is created.

title: Attendance Reviews — filter, select and review team records
caption: Current search and review form, captured 13 November 2026. This accessible date scope contains no records. Disabled actions illustrate the unselected state, not a completed approval.
publication: Read-only capture on 13 November 2026. No attendance or payroll transaction was performed for this screenshot.
crop: ERP workspace only: browser tabs, address bar, bookmarks, account header and unrelated sidebar removed.

focus.explanation: Choose From date, To date, employee/document text and department. Date controls support the calendar picker.
Select an eligible record to read its punches, review status and history. Empty results can mean no matching records or no access in the chosen scope.
Provide a meaningful submission or review comment; a blank comment is not a valid decision.
Bulk approval uses the searched date/employee/department scope. It rechecks each submitted record and skips ineligible or changed records.
Only an authorized assigned supervisor/delegate can decide; seeing a record is not sufficient authority to approve it.

outcome: Check the individual review result and audit event. Supervisor approval does not itself complete the native document or payroll.

title: Attendance Period Control — readiness comes before closing
caption: Current HR Admin form, captured 13 November 2026 with no selected period. The screenshot shows controls only; no period was created, closed or reopened.
publication: Read-only capture on 13 November 2026. No attendance or payroll transaction was performed for this screenshot.
crop: ERP workspace only: browser tabs, address bar, bookmarks, account header and unrelated sidebar removed.

focus.explanation: Use the reviewed organization, name, date range and cutoff. A period is the control scope for attendance processing.
Select the period and inspect its blockers before closing. Resolve missing setup, outstanding reviews and pending calculations through their owning workflows.
An exception needs evidence and an authorized treatment. Do not turn missing punches into absence automatically.
Use a reason and the supported state transition. Linked payroll incidences can prevent reopening and may require a later compensating correction.

outcome: Readiness is clear, the cutoff requirements are met and the period reports Closed. Payroll handoff is still a separate action.

title: Attendance Payroll Handoff — select periods, review units and stage drafts
caption: Current HR Admin form, captured 13 November 2026. No closed attendance period is selected, so both source previews are empty and staging is disabled. Reconciliation continues below the visible area.
publication: Read-only capture on 13 November 2026. No attendance or payroll transaction was performed for this screenshot.
crop: ERP workspace only: browser tabs, address bar, bookmarks, account header and unrelated sidebar removed.

focus.explanation: The payroll period must cover the entire attendance period and belong to the correct payroll.
Select the reviewed manual input concept, documented unit, rounding and mapping reference. Do not infer a conversion from the display label alone.
Overtime comes from a separate payable overtime decision. Regular attendance comes from its independently approved quantity and keeps its DAY / HOUR / MINUTE unit.
Review sources and quantities before staging. Staging is not incidence completion or payroll finalization.
Scroll down to compare source links and incidence states. Retry the protected workflow rather than entering duplicate payroll inputs.

outcome: Each staged source has one traceable Draft incidence, then a different authorized checker completes incidence review before the normal payroll run.

title: Attendance Operations Reports — select a report and inspect the summary
caption: Current HR Admin report filters and summary, captured 13 November 2026 in the demo company. The selected report is Roster & policy assignment coverage. Its results table is below this crop; open that table to investigate individual findings.
publication: Read-only capture on 13 November 2026. No attendance or payroll transaction was performed for this screenshot.
crop: ERP workspace and report summary only; excludes browser chrome, account header, sidebar and the lower results table.

focus.explanation: Choose the relevant organization and report type. Access is restricted by the role and selected organization.
Review the whole operating or payroll range. A correct setup today does not prove coverage on every earlier day.
Read the detail column for missing or ambiguous assignments. Zero summary counts do not override a row that explicitly reports missing setup.
Export the chosen report for follow-up. Exports contain up to 2,000 rows; evidence reports export metadata, not the attached evidence files.

outcome: Resolve the underlying setup or workflow issue, refresh the same scope and verify the finding is cleared; the report itself does not change attendance.

focus.explanation: Choose the reviewed work organization whose employee-days should be generated.
Use the required date range, at most 31 days per run. Verify roster, policy, calendar and assignment coverage first.
Select the configured attendance type used for this organization and workflow.
Run only after reviewing the parameters. Job scheduling does not remove setup or access checks.

outcome: Expected days and missing evidence are available for review. This process does not invent punches, classify absence, approve attendance or process payroll.
